name: s3-lab-workspace
description: Search the shared S3 research memory and build editable lab-meeting slides from one install.

interface.shortDescription: Research memory and lab-meeting slides in one install
interface.longDescription: Search and extend the lab's shared S3 Research Memory, then turn research progress into editable PowerPoint decks with the lab's template and visual-quality checks. The plugin connects directly to the central HTTPS MCP service and does not depend on a personal app ID.
defaultPrompt: Find relevant S3 research lessons, then outline this week's lab-meeting deck.
Build an editable lab-meeting deck from this research material.
Save this evidence-backed lesson to S3 Research Memory.
